methods_en: Within the same gaze pilot, previously visited rates were compared between true targets and distance-matched old locations. Visit count, dwell, maximum fixation and recency ranked already-seen candidates. Four-step post-return scanpaths were compared with distance-matched null paths.
results_en: Previously visited rates were 0.7447 for true targets and 0.6609 for controls. Trial-equal excess was 0.1206, with a bootstrap interval of 0.0557–0.1861. Candidate ranks for count, dwell, maximum fixation, recency and recency×dwell were 0.5135/0.5043/0.4799/0.5055/0.5076. Four-step set overlap was 0.2818 versus 0.2934; exact sequence overlap was 0.313 versus 0.317.
interpretation_en: Prior visits make historical locations available for return. Candidate selection calls for richer relational information, and the post-return paths motivate reinstatement of useful relations rather than literal replay of a scanpath.
